name: finance.norman/formation-planner
title: Norman: Start a company
description: Open your GmbH, UG, sp. z o.o. or JDG: steps and fees in chat, then Norman prepares the documents.

tools.name: norman_de_company_formation
tools.description: Gives the steps to open a German GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) from the number of founders and the share capital. Returns the legal form the capital allows (GmbH from 25,000 €, otherwise UG), whether the statutory Musterprotokoll fits (up to 3 founders, one managing director, no clauses of their own), the minimum deposit before the register application, the notary and commercial register fees as an estimated range (the notary's invoice under the GNotKG decides), the steps that follow, what Norman does next (checks the company name, writes the founding documents, finds notaries in the city and contacts the chosen notary to arrange the appointment), and continueInNorman, a link that opens Norman's chat for starting the company with this plan filled in. Rules only: no account access, nothing is saved, and the result is general information, not legal or tax advice. The inputs hold no personal data: companyName is the planned company's name, and there are no fields for founders' names, birth dates, addresses or email.

year.description: Year of the rules and rates: 2026.

founders.description: Number of founders (shareholders); Norman supports up to 5.

managingDirectors.description: Number of managing directors; defaults to 1.

individualArticles.description: True when the founders want articles of their own instead of the statutory template.

companyName.description: Planned name of the company, not a person's name.

businessPurpose.description: Unternehmensgegenstand: one concrete sentence on what the company does.

idea.description: The user's business idea in their own words.

tools.name: norman_pl_spzoo_formation
tools.description: Gives the steps to open a Polish spółka z o.o. from the number of shareholders and the share capital (from 5,000 zł, paid in full). Returns the S24 route next to a notarial deed (court fee 250 zł or 500 zł, PCC at 0.5% of the capital less the court fee; the notary's own fee is not estimated), the deadlines after the KRS entry (capital, PCC-3, ZUS, CRBR, NIP-8, VAT-R), CIT figures on one example profit, what Norman does next (the values for the S24 articles, the links for the other signers, and the PCC-3, NIP-8, ZUS and CRBR files), and continueInNorman, a link that opens Norman's sp. z o.o. planner with this plan. The founders sign and file in S24 or at a notary themselves; the tool files nothing and checks no company name. Rules only: nothing is saved, and the result is general information without a recommendation of a tax form, CIT rate or ZUS scheme, not legal or tax advice. The inputs hold no personal data: there are no fields for names, PESEL, NIP, addresses or email.

year.description: Year of the rules and rates: 2026.

founders.description: Number of shareholders; Norman's planner supports up to 5.

shareCapital.description: Share capital in whole złoty, at least 5,000.

companyName.description: Planned name of the company, not a person's name.

businessPurpose.description: What the company will do, in one concrete sentence.

idea.description: The user's business idea in their own words.

tools.name: norman_pl_jdg_formation
tools.description: Compares the three income tax forms for a new Polish sole proprietorship (JDG) for 2026: progressive scale, flat tax and lump-sum tax (ryczałt), each with social ZUS, health contribution, PIT and net income, from monthly revenue and costs and the founder's ZUS situation. Also returns the CEIDG, tax form, ZUS and VAT steps, what Norman does next (the details for the CEIDG-1, which the founder signs and sends) and continueInNorman, a link that opens Norman's JDG planner with these answers. situation: new = no business in the last 60 months and no work for a former employer (ulga na start, then preferential ZUS); recent = a business in the last 60 months (full ZUS); employment = also employed at least at the minimum wage (health contribution only); former_employer = the same work for this or last year's employer (full ZUS, ryczałt not available). Without lumpSumRate the ryczałt row is left out. Figures only: nothing is saved, and the result is general information without a recommendation of a tax form or ZUS scheme, not legal or tax advice. The inputs hold no personal data.

year.description: Year of the rules and rates: 2026.

monthlyRevenue.description: Expected monthly revenue in złoty, net of VAT.

monthlyCosts.description: Expected monthly business costs in złoty, net of VAT.

situation.description: The founder's ZUS situation: new, recent, employment or former_employer.

lumpSumRate.description: Ryczałt rate in percent that applies to the activity; without it the ryczałt row is left out.

companyName.description: Business name (firma) the founder plans, if any.

city.description: City of the business in Poland.

idea.description: The user's business idea in their own words.
